summary.text: Carol S. Moss is a Democratic member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 34 in Salt Lake County and has served since January 2001. She is a retired high school teacher.

paragraphs.text: Moss earned a B.A. and an M.A. in English from the University of Utah and also studied educational administration there.
She sits on the House Education Committee and the House Public Utilities and Energy Committee, and her official profile lists her as House co-chair of the Utah Fire Caucus.
Her listed honors include Teacher of the Year from the Kiwanis Club and the Salt Lake Tribune's "Captain Courageous" Legislative Achievement Award.
